setup_required: First launch: create the administrator account using the link printed in the server logs.
error_unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check that it is running.
error_invalid_response: The server answered with an unexpected response.
error_client_too_old: This app is too old for the server (server requires API {min}–{max}). Please update the app.
error_server_too_old: The server is too old for this app (server supports API {min}–{max}). Please update the server.
error_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error_unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
mfa_description: We sent a one-time code to {email}. Enter it to finish signing in.
error_otp_invalid: This code is invalid or has expired.
forgot_description: Enter your account email. If it exists, we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot_sent: If an account exists for this address, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.
error_reset_token: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
reset_done: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in.
files_empty_body: Drop files anywhere on this page or use Upload to add your first files.
brand_headline: A calm home for your files.
brand_body: Files, photos and documents on hardware you control. Private by design, fast everywhere.
feature_private: Your data never leaves your server
feature_realtime: In sync across all your devices
error_name_invalid: Names cannot contain “/” and cannot be only dots.
error_name_taken: An item with this name already exists here.
folder_empty_body: Drop files here or use Upload.
error_load: Could not load this page. Check your connection and try again.
folder_not_found: This folder does not exist or was deleted.
trash_note: Items in the trash are deleted permanently after 30 days.
trash_empty_body: Deleted files and folders stay here for 30 days before they are removed for good.
delete_forever_body: “{name}” and everything inside it will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
error_restore_conflict: An item named “{name}” already exists in its original folder. Rename one of them first.
error_download: The download could not start. Try again.
move_partial: {failed} of {total} items could not be moved (a name is already taken in the destination, or a folder cannot go inside itself).
trash_partial: {failed} of {total} items could not be moved to the trash.
drag_hint: Drop on a folder to move
viewer_unavailable: No preview available for this file.
viewer_text_truncated: Only the beginning of the file is shown.
share_password_hint: At least 4 characters. Share it separately from the link.
share_once_note: Copy this link now: for your security it will not be shown again.
shared_note: Anyone with a link can view the item until it expires or you revoke it.
shared_empty_body: Use “Share…” on a file or folder to create a public link.
public_locked_body: Enter the password you received to open it.
public_not_found: This link does not exist or has been revoked.
storage_almost_full: Almost full. Empty the trash or delete files to free space.
totp_step_body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
totp_invalid: This code is not valid. Check your device's time and try again.
security_2fa_off: Add a second step when you sign in: a code from an authenticator app such as Aegis, 2FAS or Google Authenticator.
security_2fa_on: On. Signing in requires a code from your authenticator app.
security_scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
security_manual: Can't scan it? Enter this key manually:
security_confirm_code: Then enter the 6-digit code it shows
security_codes_body: Each code works once if you lose your device. Store them somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.
security_confirm_body: Enter your password and a code from your app (or a recovery code).
setup_welcome_body: A few steps and your server is ready: create the administrator account, optionally set up email, check storage.
setup_token_hint: It is in the setup link printed by the server on first launch (for Docker: docker compose logs alcove).
setup_token_invalid: This setup token is not valid. Copy it again from the server logs.
setup_already_done: This server is already set up.
setup_admin_body: This account manages the server (admin console) and is also your account in the app.
setup_email_body: Needed for password resets and email codes. You can set it up later in the admin console.
smtp_test_ok: Test email sent. Check your inbox.
setup_failed: Setup failed. Check the details and try again.
system_up_to_date: You are running the latest version.
system_update_command: Run this on the server to update:
update_confirm_body: The database is backed up first, then the server restarts. It takes about a minute; open pages reconnect by themselves.
update_failed: The update could not be installed: {error}
update_timeout: The new version did not start in time. On the server, run: sudo alcove rollback
photos_empty_body: Photos and videos you add anywhere in Files appear here, sorted by the date they were taken.
photos_favorites_empty: Mark photos with the heart to find them here.
photo_no_preview: No preview yet. Install ffmpeg on the server for video and HEIC previews.
albums_empty_body: Group photos into albums, then share them with people who have an account on this server.
album_share_intro: People with an account on this server. Viewers see the album; contributors can also add their own photos.
album_share_already: This person is already in the album.
album_share_unknown: No account with this email on this server.
album_delete_body: The album is deleted for everyone it is shared with. The photos stay in your files.
album_empty_owner: This album is empty. Add photos from your timeline.
album_empty_viewer: This album is empty for now.
album_gone_body: It was deleted, or it is no longer shared with you.
share_album_note: Anyone with the link sees the album as it is now, without signing in. Photos are shown as previews, without their location or camera details; videos play from the original file, which may contain its own metadata.
duplicates_intro: Identical copies and visually similar photos (resized, recompressed, bursts). Choose what to keep; the rest goes to the trash, where you can restore it.
duplicates_none_body: Your library has no identical or very similar photos.
duplicates_marked: {name}, will be moved to the trash

match.countPlural=one: {count} item moved to the trash ({size} freed once it is emptied).
match.countPlural=other: {count} items moved to the trash ({size} freed once it is emptied).

match.countPlural=one: {count} item will be moved to the trash, keeping your choices for each group ({size}). You can restore it from the trash.
match.countPlural=other: {count} items will be moved to the trash, keeping your choices for each group ({size}). You can restore them from the trash.

map_empty: No photo has a location yet. Phones usually record it when location is enabled for the camera.
admin_map_body: Off: everyone sees a simple world map built into Alcove, with no request leaving your server. On: browsers load street-level tiles from OpenStreetMap, which then sees the IP address and the area viewed.
users_new_note: A password is generated; you give it to the person, who can change it in Account.
users_password_body: Give this password to {email}. It is shown only once; they can change it in Account.
users_delete_body: The account and everything it owns are deleted for good: files, photos, albums and links. This cannot be undone.
users_delete_confirm: Type the email address to confirm
account_password_note: After the change you are signed out everywhere and sign in again with the new password.
account_wrong_password: The current password is not right.
account_password_changed: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.
account_mobile_body: Browse your photos and files, and back up your phone's photos automatically. After installing, enter this server's address.
account_mobile_ios: The iPhone app comes later. Android may ask you to allow installing apps from your browser.
